invariants.rationale: The method always returns a new merged Element unless template or parent is null, in which case it returns the non-null argument. All paths return non-null if either parameter is non-null.

invariants.expression: (parent == null) != (template == null) ? result == (parent != null ? parent : template) : true
invariants.rationale: If exactly one of parent/template is null, result returns the non-null one; otherwise, a new merged result is returned.
The resulting Element's name is set based on the template's name if template is non-null, otherwise falls back to parent.
When both parent and template are non-null, result is a newly created Element and not either argument.

invariants.expression: result.getChildCount() >= Math.max(parent != null ? parent.getChildCount() : 0, template != null ? template.getChildCount() : 0)
invariants.rationale: The merged element will have at least as many children as the maximum of parent or template.
